test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following government departments is associated with infrastructure development in India?
solution:
The Correct answer is the __**Department of Economic Affairs**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Department of Economic Affairs (DEA) **operates within the **Ministry of Finance **in the Government of India.
 
• Its responsibilities include advising the government on e**conomic matters, drafting the annual Union Budget, implementing economic policies**, and **overseeing financial sectors **such as infrastructure.
 
• Playing a crucial role in infrastructure finance, the DEA mobilizes resources for infrastructure development and formulates fiscal policies conducive to growth.
 
• It also coordinates with other government bodies and international organizations on economic and infrastructure projects.
 
• Collaborating with various ministries and departments, the DEA ensures the efficient implementation of infrastructure projects across sectors like transportation, energy, and urban development.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Sir Ramasamy Chetty Kandasamy Shanmukham Chetty**, born on October 17, 1892,, held the distinction of being the** inaugural Finance Minister **of independent India.
 
• He delivered the inaugural budget of independent India on November 26, 1947.
 
• **Dr. T. V. Somanathan **currently serves as the secretary of this department.
